_comment: Registry of independent paper-trading simulations. Each runs its own portfolio/ledger/decision history under state/<id>/. The bot runs every strategy each cycle against one shared market snapshot. cadenceMinutes is documentation of the workflow cron.

strategies.label: Core
strategies.blurb: Semi-long-term. EGX30 only, minimum 5 trading-day holds, at most 2 trades per cycle, low turnover and a few higher-conviction positions.

strategies.label: Swing
strategies.blurb: Active. Around 91 liquid EGX names, no minimum hold, up to 3 trades per cycle. Aims for roughly +2 to 3% per position over one to two weeks and cuts losers near -3 to 4%. Every exit is the model's call.
